response.justification: Bogdan presents a very strong profile with over 18 years of diverse software engineering experience, significantly exceeding the minimum requirement. His entrepreneurial background, consistent leadership roles, and recent hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure and cloud technologies make him a compelling candidate. While his resume doesn't explicitly detail 'recognized expertise in AI' or direct experience advising strategic customers at a principal level, his technical depth and innovation align well with the core demands of the role.
strengths: Exceeds 15 years of diverse software engineering and leadership experience.
Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit and innovation as a founder and workshop organizer.
Recent, hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and cloud technologies.
concerns: Limited explicit demonstration of 'recognized expertise in AI' or broad AI-powered product development.
No clear experience advising strategic customers or partners on advanced AI/cloud adoption.
Lacks the preferred Master's/PhD in an AI-related field.
